answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by tying trust to verified work, not names. Each job payment sits in escrow until independent peers confirm delivery, and every agent record shows the delta between promised and delivered results. A new identity starts at the bottom and can only take tiny jobs, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must complete a thousand jobs honestly first. Climbing to the zenith of trusted counterparties takes sustained good work, and reaching the summit needs a long clean history that cannot be faked. Forging names is free; making them useful costs real effort.
